newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia 3-mth KLIBOR refixed at 8.76 pct.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia 3-mth KLIBOR refixed at 8.76 pct.

text.p: Malaysia's benchmark three-month Kuala Lumpur Interbank Offered Rate (KLIBOR) was refixed at 8.76 percent at 0830 GMT.
At 0300 GMT, the three-month KLIBOR was fixed at 7.53 percent and at 7.51 percent on Thursday.
The one-month KLIBOR was refixed at 8.97 percent against 7.57 earlier and 7.47 percent on Thursday.
The rates were refixed after the regular daily fixing at 0300 GMT was found to be sharply different from interbank dealing rates.
KLIBOR is fixed by taking an average of rates offered by various banks in the country.
Dealers said out of 20 banks which contribute the rates for KLIBOR fixing, 16 did not update the rates ahead of the 0300 GMT fixing due to volatility in the interbank market.
Money market dealers said the volatility in interbank rates was triggered by a liquidity squeeze. The overnight and one-week money were traded as high as 20 percent on Friday, they said.
One-month interbank rate ended at 8.5/9.0 percent and three-month at 8.0/8.5 percent, dealers said.
